name: West Virginia University Potomac State College
tuition_note: In-state (WV resident) tuition & fees from admissions.potomacstatecollege.edu/cost-and-aid/tuition-and-fees: associate degree base rate $2,808/semester ($2,496 tuition + $312 fees) x2 = $5,616/year. Housing $6,340/year (room only, on-campus PSC housing) listed as a separate 'Other Costs Per Year' line item from food ($6,248). Page footer indicates current (2025-26) rates; academic year not explicitly labeled on page.
